svg.title: Q202304 exam-style Bode diagram
svg.desc: Logarithmic frequency in rad/s. Black magnitude asymptotes with corners 2,2.5,3,10,50. Slopes -20,0,-20,0,-20,-40 dB/dec. Phase initially rises from -90 degrees, then tends to -180 degrees. Dashed constructions use the asymptotic crossover 12.5 and its phase margin 103.3 degrees.
